description: Opere ed infrastrutture portuali per Porto - Anno is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Il dataset contiene dati sulle infrastrutture portuali italiane e su alcune delle loro principali caratteristiche. Le informazioni sono state fornite dalle Capitanerie di Porto e dalle Autorità Portuali e sono aggiornate al 31 dicembre 2010. Si riferiscono a 256 porti e 1.761 accosti presenti lungo i litorali della Penisola. Coverage: Italy. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Its tags are accosti, infrastrutture, minf, porti. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
